statement.p: A graph of f is shown above. The numbers shown represent the geometric area of each region. Evaluate the following definite integrals.

static.solution:
Solution:
Find the signed area, using the graph.
a) The region between x = 0 and x = 1 represents a negative net area, so \int_0^{1} f(x) \, dx = -82.6.
b) Split the integral \int_{0}^{2} f(x) \, dx = \int_{0}^{1} f(x) \, dx + \int_{1}^{2} f(x) \, dx = -82.6 + 15.4 = -67.2.
c) Split the integral \int_{0}^{3} f(x) \, dx = \int_{0}^{2} f(x) \, dx + \int_{2}^{3} f(x) \, dx = -67.2 + 29.4 = -37.8.
d) Pull out the constant multiple. \int_{1}^{2} 9 f(x) \, dx = 9 \int_{1}^{2} f(x) \, dx = 9(15.4) = 138.6.
